reason: Applies the needs-stale judgement on the local fine-tune-stack maintainer. The Need's task was the one-shot ship of the fused local fine-tune-to-agent-to-data workbench, which is this prediction's own observed precondition, and three bridges record it delivered and iterating: validation.082cc2f522385a0a (2026-06-20), validation.2146426d6c8b6323 (2026-06-28, v0.1.471-beta) and validation.67cf6a23288fb2ac (2026-07-16, same-day support for that day's open-weight flagship). The precondition is satisfied, so the Need is re-scoped forward to what a managed copier now needs from the local stack - continuous flagship coverage keeping the reference loop portable - rather than the initial fusion. The judgement's own confidence note holds: the prior job text read as ongoing extension work while its task was a completed one-shot, and that mismatch is what this rewrite resolves. The when text is carried over verbatim because the runway itself did not change; only the work inside it did.
